contract.label_source: Original published OpenRadioss ANIM; binary float32 extraction and deterministic initial-area cell-to-node projection

normalization_groups.definition: sqrt(trace(training displacement covariance)/3), shared by all three vector components

displacement_x.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

displacement_y.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

displacement_z.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

inplane_vm_upper.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

inplane_vm_lower.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

EPSP_upper.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

EPSP_lower.relative_l2_definition: sqrt(sum((prediction-truth)^2)/sum(truth^2)) over all evaluation cases, support points and times; undefined when denominator is zero

inference_timing_note: Includes streamed training-field reconstruction, target-cache read and prediction/truth file writes; excludes metric calculation and initial kernel-weight solve.
normalization_note: Shared frozen train-only field scales: displacement XYZ share sqrt(trace covariance/3); scalar fields use individual training std. Training spatial mean field removed; equal channel/node/time MSE, no labels clipped.
selection_note: Twelve RBF gamma/alpha combinations; validation equal-weight normalized MSE across nodes, time and channels. Test cases are read for final evaluation only.
prediction_scope: Registered mesh, globals listed in common cache; initial13 coupon cases split5train/4validation/4test. No unseen topology or whole-appliance generalization tested.
kernel_definition: exp(-gamma * squared Euclidean distance in train-normalized globals), unit amplitude, ridge alpha, no polynomial term
out_of_core_note: Float32 disk training matrix; float64 inner products accumulated in coordinate chunks. No full dual-coefficient field matrix or candidate prediction ensemble is held in RAM.
memory_note: RSS sampled at setup/selection/evaluation boundaries; lower bound on process peak.
